verdict.rationale: Context.dev's monitoring feature lets a user define what to watch (a page, sitemap, or structured dataset) and receive signed change events automatically when that content changes. That is a first-party, event-driven automation primitive, but the evidence describes only change detection plus event delivery, not configurable rules that run arbitrary actions. Detection runs on a recurring schedule rather than reacting to arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a documented rule/condition engine, configurable automated actions beyond event delivery, triggers for event types other than content changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.
